'''Cees Lensink Wookiees on Tatooine''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Cees Lensink]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls59.htm Wookiees on Tatooine], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228074325/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls59.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Cees Lensink]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
